description: URL-encode or decode text, choosing between full-URL encoding and component encoding, with errors on malformed input.

faqs.a: Full URL (encodeURI) keeps URL structure characters like : / ? & intact, while Component (encodeURIComponent) encodes everything except a few safe characters — use it for query values.
faqs.q: What is the difference between full URL and component encoding?

faqs.a: Decoding malformed percent-sequences throws a URIError, which the tool catches and shows as a friendly error message.
faqs.q: What happens with malformed input when decoding?

faqs.a: Yes — all encoding and decoding happens locally in your browser.

howto: Paste the text or URL into the input box.
Pick Full URL or Component encoding mode.
Copy the result to your clipboard.
title: URL Encoder / Decoder
